data.title: BlackRock's Bitcoin Fund Just Paid Its First Dividend: 18.5% Annualized, While Bitcoin Sleeps at $65K
data.description: BlackRock just launched a Bitcoin fund that writes covered calls to generate monthly income, and its debut distribution caught a lot of IBIT holders off guard. Before you dismiss it or rush into it, there are some tradeoffs that could change the math entirely.
data.author: David Beren
